title: Command Center · Engine on problem
description: Runs the paging engine of the Command Center app (my.command.center) as soon as Davis opens or closes a problem, so the first page does not wait for the interval of "Command Center · Engine". Simple workflow: one task, no workflow hours. Keep "Command Center · Engine" installed: escalations need its clock. [command-center-engine-on-problem v1]
